issues.description: The UML in problem_statement.md declares Stock.add(String) as returning void (UML shows +add(String): void), but both the template and solution implementations of Stock.add(String) return int. This discrepancy between the problem statement UML and the provided code can confuse students about the expected method signature and return type.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the UML in problem_statement.md consistent with the code: change the UML signature to +add(String): int (and ensure +take(String): int). Alternatively, if the intended design is for add to be void, update the template and solution Stock.add implementation to return void and adjust any call sites accordingly. Prefer updating the UML to match the existing template/solution signatures to avoid breaking provided code.
